subject: general
question: What was the theme of the World Food Forum (WFF) held in Rome from 14-18 October 2024?

options.text: Healthy food for all, for today and tomorrow
Good food for all, for today and tomorrow
Nutritious food for all, for today and tomorrow
Good food for all, for today and forever

solution:
The correct answer is __**Good food for all, for today and tomorrow**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **World Food Forum (WFF) 2024** was held from **14 to 18 October 2024** at the headquarters of the **Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO)** of the **United Nations** in **Rome, Italy**.
 
• The official theme for the **2024** edition was "**Good food for all, for today and tomorrow**," which emphasizes the necessity of building sustainable agrifood systems that provide nutritional security for the current and future generations. ***Hence, statement 2 is correct.***
 
• The theme "Healthy food for all, for today and tomorrow" is incorrect because, while health is a component, the official branding specifically utilized the word "**Good**" to encompass nutrition, accessibility, and cultural relevance. ***Hence, statement 1 is incorrect.***
 
• The theme "Nutritious food for all, for today and tomorrow" is incorrect as it does not align with the formal title designated by the **FAO** for the **2024** summit. ***Hence, statement 3 is incorrect.***
